description: This file contains platform-specific upgrade functions for the OpenWRT firmware, including a check image function and an upgrade routine that defaults to a general upgrade method based on the board name.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Function to verify the firmware image, always returns success in this implementation.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Function to perform the firmware upgrade, defaults to 'default_do_upgrade' for all board names.
